name: Face Skin Smoothness
description: Analyzes excessive skin smoothness from AI generation
algorithm: Face Skin Smoothness — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial skin smoothness for video deepfake detection:

1. **肌領域Segmentation**: Facial skin regions are segmented per frame, separating skin from eyes, eyebrows, lips, and hair. The skin regions — forehead, cheeks, nose, chin — are analyzed independently for texture quality.

2. **テクスチャ周波数分析**: High-frequency skin texture content is measured using local power spectral density. Natural skin contains multi-scale texture: pores (~0.5-1mm spacing), fine wrinkles, and skin grain. The method quantifies texture energy at these characteristic spatial frequencies. AI-generated skin often shows suppressed high-frequency texture — the over-smoothing artifact common in GAN-generated faces.

3. **Smoothness勾配検出**: The method maps smoothness variation across the face. Natural faces show region-dependent smoothness: smoother on cheeks, more textured on the nose and forehead. Deepfake faces may show unnaturally uniform smoothness or incorrect smoothness distribution across facial regions.

4. **肌DetailPreservation評価**: Fine skin details (individual pores, hair follicles, micro-wrinkles) are evaluated for rendering quality. These details help assess whether the skin texture is photographed (with characteristic sensor-captured detail) versus rendered (often lacking sub-pixel detail or showing repetitive synthetic patterns).

5. **時間的肌テクスチャ安定性**: Natural skin texture is static — pores and micro-features remain in fixed positions frame-to-frame. The method tracks skin texture consistency over time. Deepfake generators may produce temporally varying skin texture where pore patterns shift, appear, or disappear between frames, creating detectable temporal texture instability.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through face skin smoothness analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
